title: Branding
description: Your colour, logo and sender name: the web app, the mail you send and your PDF documents show them.
locked: The operators locked the branding of this tenant. It can't be changed here.

color.label: Brand colour
color.hint: The accent of buttons and links in the web app, mail and documents.

darkColor.label: Brand colour, dark mode
darkColor.hint: The accent in the web app's dark theme. Without one, the brand colour is used.

mailName.label: Mail sender name
mailName.hint: The name mail is sent under and signed with. The address stays the deployment's.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image. It shows in the menu, in mail and on documents.
logo.limit: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB
logo.typeRefused: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

darkLogo.label: Logo, dark mode
darkLogo.hint: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image for the web app's dark theme. Without one, the logo is used.
darkLogo.limit: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB
darkLogo.typeRefused: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

error.title: The branding could not be loaded
